Noir Yoga

Welcome to Noir Yoga, a collection of vibrant and inclusive yoga studios nestled in the heart of Bedford-Stuyvesant, Brooklyn. As a Black-owned business, we are dedicated to creating a welcoming spaces that celebrates diversity, fosters community, and promotes holistic well-being for everyone.

At Noir Yoga, we believe in the transformative power of yoga to bring balance, strength, and peace to our lives. Our mission is to make yoga accessible to all, regardless of age, experience, or background. Whether you're a seasoned practitioner or new to the mat, our diverse range of classes and skilled instructors will guide you on your journey towards physical, mental, and spiritual wellness.

Our studios offer a variety of yoga styles, from dynamic Vinyasa flows to restorative Yin sessions, ensuring that there is something for everyone. We also provide specialized workshops, meditation sessions, and wellness events designed to enrich your practice and support your overall health.

Community is at the heart of Noir Yoga. We strive to build connections and create a supportive environment where everyone feels valued and empowered. Join us for our community classes, social events, and collaborative projects that bring together like-minded individuals passionate about wellness and personal growth.

Step into Noir Yoga and discover a sanctuary where you can breathe, stretch, and grow. We are excited to be part of your wellness journey and look forward to practicing with you.

Founder

Dr. Mason Mason is the passionate founder of Noir Yoga, a dedicated space for wellness and community in Bedford -Stuyvesant, Brooklyn. As a lifelong educator and yoga practitioner, Dr. Mason brings a unique blend of academic expertise, holistic health knowledge, and deep personal experience to the studio.

With a distinguished career in education, Dr. Mason has spent decades nurturing minds, fostering creativity, and advocating for inclusive learning environments. This commitment to empowerment and growth naturally extends to his approach to yoga, where he emphasizes accessibility, inclusivity, and the profound benefits of a consistent practice.

Dr. Mason’s yoga journey began over 20 years ago, leading to a transformative path of self-discovery and healing. His classes are known for their warmth, inclusivity, and attention to the individual needs of each student.

At Noir Yoga, Dr. Mason is dedicated to building a community where everyone feels welcomed and supported. His vision is to create a sanctuary where people of all backgrounds can come together to breathe, move, and grow both on and off the mat.

Dr. Mason’s passion for yoga and education is matched by his commitment to social justice and community building. He believes in the power of yoga to not only transform individuals but also to foster connections and create positive change in the broader community.

Join Mason at Noir Yoga and embark on a journey towards holistic wellbeing, guided by a leader who embodies the principles of empathy, compassion, and community.
